overview.description: State Street My2032 High Yield Corporate Bond ETF is an actively managed target-maturity exchange-traded fund that seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. The fund primarily invests in U.S. dollar-denominated high-yield corporate bonds maturing in or around 2032 and is designed to distribute remaining principal and liquidate on or about December 15, 2032.
